summary: Run a modular application with Node.js (Fastify) and regional relational storage or approved local infrastructure.Use synthetic data and sandbox payments until production eligibility is verified.

frontend.justification: Covers the requested web, android clients.

alternatives.why_not: Separate clients increase parallel implementation and testing work.

tradeoffs: Validate accessibility and platform-specific behavior separately.

backend.justification: Scored 31.2 (language fit 15.0, delivery 15.0, realtime 1.2). Matches declared skills: typescript, javascript.

alternatives.why_not: Scored 30.6 (language fit 15.0, delivery 15.0, realtime 0.6). The winning stack has the higher weighted score.

tradeoffs: Ratings are planning heuristics. Benchmark application throughput with production-like payloads.

database.justification: Relational storage provides transactions and constraints for a balanced workload.

alternatives.why_not: Would move relational consistency checks into application code.

tradeoffs: Index and load-test representative queries and rehearse restores.

hosting.justification: Run the workload in ap-south-1 using the selected deployment model.

alternatives.why_not: Adds a separate operations and infrastructure footprint.

tradeoffs: Check regional quotas, service coverage and availability targets.

supporting.justification: Keep identity data on the chosen infrastructure. Add an SMS adapter and verify carrier terms.

alternatives.why_not: Adds an external processor and separate data-location review.

tradeoffs: Operate and patch the identity server.

supporting.justification: Keep uploads and backups inside the chosen deployment boundary.

alternatives.why_not: Large objects increase database backup and restore load.

tradeoffs: Set access controls, retention and backup policies.

supporting.justification: Host the connection and fan-out path with the application. Use a continuously available service and verify connection duration limits.

alternatives.why_not: Repeated requests add delay and traffic for live sessions.

tradeoffs: Test reconnect, fan-out and concurrency. Collaborative editing also needs conflict resolution.

supporting.justification: Reuse the transactional database and avoid operating a second search service.

alternatives.why_not: Needs a separate index and synchronization.

tradeoffs: Benchmark ranking and indexing with representative content.

supporting.justification: Use hosted checkout and keep card entry outside the application.

alternatives.why_not: Expands sensitive-data handling and audit scope.

tradeoffs: Confirm processor eligibility, transfer terms and webhook verification.

supporting.justification: Keep builds portable and publish only approved artifacts.
tradeoffs: Maintain build reproducibility and dependency provenance.

supporting.justification: Collect telemetry without requiring a third-party endpoint.
tradeoffs: Redact sensitive fields and bound retention.

The USD 150/month budget plan assumes a limited pilot cohort instead of the full 12-month forecast of 30000 users. The cost band remains the full-scope planning estimate. Keep the requested features and service targets for the pilot, and expand only after measured costs and load tests support it.

capacity_plan.request_rate_basis: Estimated from 800 concurrent users at one request per user every 20 seconds.
capacity_plan.database_storage_basis: 20 GB floor, 30% headroom, and 20% of stored data allocated to database records.
capacity_plan.failover: Start with a primary database and rehearse restore from a backup.
capacity_plan.verification: Benchmark the 100 RPS planning target with actual request mix, connection pooling, and failure of one replica. Validate database IOPS, retention, and restore times.

allocations.control: Keep the planned 1 serving replicas as the pilot baseline. Limit admission and approve scaling only after measuring peak load and availability.
Keep backups and required redundancy. Review database utilization before increasing capacity.
Set per-account upload size and volume limits. Track storage and egress.
Include carrier charges in this envelope where SMS is used. Limit retries and track cost per successful sign-in.
Limit concurrent sessions per rollout cohort and measure fan-out before opening enrollment.

budget_fit_plan.rollout: Start with one rollout cohort. Preserve realtime and payment flows. Gate new enrollment on observed session and transaction costs.
budget_fit_plan.acceptance: Price every line in the required region, including omitted provider fees where applicable. Load-test the planned cohort against the requested SLOs. If it exceeds an envelope, reduce cohort size or raise the budget before launch.
budget_fit_plan.tradeoff: This is a spend allocation for a smaller rollout. It does not cover the full forecast or impose a provider billing cap.
